cohort: The study included 280 full-term infants with neonatal encephalopathy who underwent continuous electroencephalography monitoring in the neonatal period.
finding: Term infants following NE are at risk of epilepsy, with a significantly higher incidence rate in infants who experienced electrographic neonatal seizures compared to those who did not.
mod_finding: Infants delivered vaginally were identified as a potential predictor for the development of later epilepsy.
followup_time: Well into the childhood period (exact duration not specified)
